integrity: The proof independently reconstructs the signed-permutation vertices and sign-vector facets of the source canonical polar pair, normalizes every facet, orders all shell radii exactly, and proves uniqueness of both incenter and minimum-enclosing center on both sides by antipodal equality arguments. Finite LP enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the canonical Euclidean representative (C_d+Diamond_d)^circ of the signohedron. Euclidean radii are not invariant under general affine equivalence, and the result does not determine extremal ellipsoids or the Euclidean geometry of every orientation-dependent monotone-path realization.
title: Canonical signohedra are tangential with \(d\) exact radial shells
